# Election update: Friday, November 6 (evening)

## Bottom line
The results table did not mark any new race called today. It stands at 409 of 435 House races called, D 253 and R 156, with 218 needed for a majority ([House table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_House_of_Representatives_elections)). Counting 6 races news outlets report as decided, it is D 254, R 161; 4 of those 6 are safe seats the table has not caught up on. In the Senate, Democrats have secured 54 seats to Republicans' 44, counting seats not up, with 51 needed ([Senate table](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_elections)). Alaska and Mississippi are still uncalled ([NBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxOaHlpN1JZb0VFc0RXekRVSTYxSVhXb0lFUkRqd19oWXdnYnJRelBjMzRrUHc2LWpoVDNOeHhJSy05eW5Ueng3eDRiWjhrcEhNZHpaTC01ZlMzVEN5OEFVdkhsLW80NFh1U3JxLV91MVFyQlZjVE9nVVRKTkpqRUVrUkNDV3hUNVY0SXZla0wxbnluT2VaYVRRU2o4eE9rZG5ZT3BXdk1WVzNkQlQwRVE3QmF2UGNia0ZRV3JOM0s4b2JwblE?oc=5)). No seat rated safe is within 5 points.

## Called since the last update
- No competitive race was newly marked called in the results table today.
- **Reported, not yet in the table:** 9NEWS reports Rep. Jeff Hurd (R) won reelection in CO-03 ([9NEWS](https://news.google.?oc=5)). WKTV reports Blake Gendebien (D) conceded NY-21 to Anthony Constantino (R) ([WKTV](https://news.google.?oc=5)). Both are counted separately until the table follows.
- **Safe seats reported called as rated:** AZ-05 (Mark Lamb, R), AZ-08 (Abe Hamadeh, R) and NC-08 (Mark Harris, R); plus TN-04, where WKRN and the Nashville Banner report Victoria Broderick (D) defeated Rep. Scott DesJarlais (R) ([Nashville Banner](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNanVudi03REZWbFRtSldvU1pzY2x3bFBTZG5sY2dkWGsxOUJBek5GZVJibmNwVEZFWm14SzBYbVFVWm9mb3JvY0FqbkpESjV0UGpPZmlHOHVMM0Q4TnBYNzd5Nmd5ZzdwdTFqT0IzVnpkYV9CWWJNVnc0alFsUk4xcTlRZVY3OGdhWlZtY3VXRnFSdw?oc=5)).
